name: Georgia Institute of Technology
character: Located in Midtown Atlanta, the campus mixes tall buildings with greenery and over 15,000 trees covering nearly 30 percent of the grounds.

landmarks.name: Tech Tower
landmarks.quote: Georgia Tech's administrative buildings, such as Tech Tower and the Bursar's Office, are also located on the Central Campus.
landmarks.look: Administrative tower building on Central Campus.

landmarks.name: Bobby Dodd Stadium
landmarks.quote: Georgia Tech football's home, Bobby Dodd Stadium, is located on East Campus
landmarks.look: Large football stadium on East Campus.

landmarks.name: Kessler Campanile
landmarks.quote: The Kessler Campanile (which is referred to by students as "The Shaft") is located next to the eastern entrance of the Student Center.
landmarks.look: Tall slender tower next to greenspace.

landmarks.name: Brittain Dining Hall
landmarks.quote: Brittain Dining Hall, a dining hall on East Campus that closed in 2024, was modeled after a medieval church, complete with carved columns and stained glass windows
landmarks.look: Medieval-church-style hall with carved columns and stained glass windows.

landmarks.name: Freshman Hill
landmarks.quote: The main road leading from East Campus to Central Campus is a steep, ascending incline commonly known as "Freshman Hill"
landmarks.look: Steep, ascending road incline between East and Central Campus.

landmarks.name: Tech Green
landmarks.quote: the G. Wayne Clough Undergraduate Learning Commons opened next to the library and occupies part of Tech Green (formerly Yellow Jacket Park).
landmarks.look: Open campus greenspace next to the library.

landmarks.name: Fifth Street Bridge
landmarks.quote: Connected by the Fifth Street Bridge, it is a pedestrian-friendly area comprising Georgia Tech facilities and retail locations.
landmarks.look: Pedestrian-friendly bridge connecting main campus to Technology Square.

landmarks.name: Robert C. Williams Museum of Papermaking
landmarks.name_en: Robert C. Williams Museum of Papermaking
landmarks.quote: The Robert C. Williams Museum of Papermaking is located on West Campus.
landmarks.look: Plain museum building on West Campus.
